content.short: Token Tails is a cat-care Web3 game where players create portraits, earn TAILS, and support shelter cats.
content.description: Token Tails is a cat-care Web3 game with a charity angle. Players look after a digital cat, create stylized portraits, track progress, earn TAILS, and support shelter cats through in-game activity. It is best understood as a social pet game built around collection, care, and rewards rather than as a standalone token page.
